sec.title: August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 299)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio, a comprehensive six-year frontier chronicle of *The Lone Ranger* and Tonto starring Earle Graser & Brace Beemer with John Todd for Silvercup Bread, Bond Bread, and Cheerios (1935–1944):
